source.notes: Typeset school paper with no usable text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. Printed header: Half Yearly Examination 2016-2017, Std. : VIII, Subject : CHEMISTRY, Full Marks : 80, Time : 2 Hrs.+15mins. (durationMinutes 135). examYear 2017 is the later year of the printed session 2016-2017. Question 1 (a–h, [5] each = 40) has no printed section heading; 'Section B [40 Marks] (Attempt any four questions)' covers Questions 2–7 (10 marks each), so the pack total (100) exceeds the 80-mark maximum; no choiceGroup is set because the choice is 'any four of six'. Where a printed mark covers a group of items it is kept as one entry with that total; [2+1] / [1+2] marks on one sentence are kept as one entry. Chemical subscripts are flattened (e.g. Fe2O3); isotope notation is rebuilt with Unicode super/subscripts. The paper's own wording ('dense white times', 'Neou', 'followings') is kept. Air-pollution questions (greenhouse effect, acid rain, ozone, smog, global warming) have chapter null because no listed chapter fits. No school name printed. No answer key.
